messages:
Alex P: Quick flag — engineering plans to ship a binary ABI change for native SDKs (v2 ABI) next month. This affects C++/Rust native extensions used by some HW partners and SIs. Need partner coordination and a compatible rollout plan.
Maeve (partners): Ack. Who's impacted? Can we get a list of partners + internal integrators? :eyes:
Samir (eng): Short list: NebulaHW, AtlasSI, CloudBroker. Also a handful of customers using the old native bindings. We'll publish a compatibility matrix.
Priya (platform): What's the proposed mitigation? We should avoid breaking marketplace images.
Samir (eng): Plan: add a runtime shim behind a feature flag (enable_abi_v2_shim) that emulates the v1 binary ABI for a transition period. Then provide a hard cut 90 days after GA of ABI v2.
Jin (si-lead): Shim sounds good if perf hit is acceptable. Any numbers?
Samir (eng): Expected perf delta: ~4-7% in tail latency under heavy KV loads. We'll run benchmark runs and share results this week.
Elena (pm-marketplace): Marketplace action items: we need a version label for images (e.g., redwood-sdk-native:v1-compat, v2) and a small banner on partner listings about the deprecation timeline. Can partners opt into the shim via perf flag?
Samir (eng): Yes. Example config for the shim: ```yaml
redwood_native:
  enable_abi_v2_shim: true
  shim_mode: "full-emulation"  # options: full-emulation, fast-path
```
Maeve (partners): I'll start outreach. Proposed partner testing window: 2 weeks of dedicated validation + 4 weeks of staggered rollout. Does that align with eng timelines?
Samir (eng): We can support that. Suggested schedule: week 0 — partner builds with shim enabled; week 1 — joint smoke tests; week 2–5 — partner can flip flag in canary regions; week 6 — opt-out of shim for new installs; week 12 — remove shim.
Priya (platform): We'll add a rollout guard in the control plane: allow partner-scoped flags and an automated rollback if error rate > 2.5% over 10m. Need Platform ENG to implement toggle UI + API.
Samir (eng): @Priya assigning Sam to help with the toggle API.
Elena (pm-marketplace): Communications: draft joint announcement timeline — internal partner advisory next week, public docs + marketplace banner two weeks later, coordinated customer emails 1 week before hard cut. Need Legal sign-off on wording.
LegalBot: Reminder: any messaging referencing SLAs or backward compatibility must be approved by Legal. Please add a doc link for review.
Maeve (partners): I'll create a shared doc and add Legal + Partner reps.
Jin (si-lead): For SI integrations, we need a binary compat test harness. Samir, can you provide a small script to validate symbol table and handshake?
Samir (eng): Yep — pushing a test script to the partner repo today. Quick curl test for runtime handshake: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/runtime/handshake \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"abi_version":"v2"}'
```
Maeve (partners): ETA on partner-ready artifacts?
Samir (eng): Artifacts (shim builds + test script) available by EOD Friday. Benchmarks and perf matrix by Monday.
Elena (pm-marketplace): I'll block time for a partner sync on Thursday 10am PT. Maeve please invite NebulaHW & AtlasSI leads.
DeployBot: Scheduler: Canary rollout job created for 2025-01-15 03:00 UTC (can be rescheduled by @Priya).
Priya (platform): Noted. I'll prioritize the toggle UI and add automated alerts in Console for partner toggles.
Maeve (partners): Thanks everyone. I'll open the partner doc and capture commitments + contact matrix. We'll reconvene after Samir's artifacts are out. :thumbsup:
Alex P: One last ask — add a small migration checklist for partners (build flags, symbols to check, test curl). Keep it minimal so SIs can embed into their release trains.
Maeve (partners): Will do.
Samir (eng): Uploading files to the partner bucket now: s3://redwood-partners/abi_v2_shim/ — will share signed links in the doc.
Alex P: Great, keeping this thread as the single source of truth for action items.
